questions.stem: I ____ believe he ____ tell lies. He is an honest boy.

options.distractor: 否定已转移，从句不能再否定
believe 是实义动词，用 don't

questions.explanation: 否定转移：I don't believe he will tell lies。

questions.stem: — Could you tell me how I can get to the zoo? — 这句话可以简化为：Could you tell me ____?

options.text: how to get to the zoo
how can get to the zoo
to get how to the zoo

questions.explanation: 简化成 how to get to the zoo。

questions.stem: I don't think he is a teacher, ____?

options.distractor: 否定已转移，疑问部分用肯定
反意疑问句要针对从句提问
要针对从句，且用肯定形式

questions.explanation: 否定转移后的反意疑问句看从句：is he?

questions.stem: We don't suppose they ____ the match. They are much weaker.

options.distractor: 否定已转移，从句不能再否定
这里说将来的事，用 will win

questions.explanation: 否定转移：don't suppose they will win。

options.text: I don't think it will rain today.
She doesn't know where to go.
I think he isn't at home now.
Please tell me when to start.

questions.explanation: 应改为 I don't think he is at home now（否定转移）。

questions.stem: — I can't decide which one I should buy. — 简化后的说法是 ____.

options.text: I can't decide which one to buy
I can't decide which one buying
I can't decide to buy which one
I can't decide which to one buy
